name: aosdf-vscode
description: AOSDF project status in the editor: status bar chip, gaps/manual-actions/prompt inbox, a link out to the Project Docs Site and the Learning Roadmap, command-surface write actions routed through a terminal into Claude Code, and multi-workspace support. VSCode ships first (evolution.md Pillar A). Internal distribution only (OD-1) — not published to the VS Code Marketplace.

aosdf.name: Inbox
aosdf.contextualTitle: AOSDF Inbox — Gaps, Manual Actions & Pending Prompts

aosdf.documentsRoot.description: Path to this product's '{project_name}-Documents/docs/' folder, relative to the workspace root ('{project_name}/', per folder_map.md). Set this to the real folder name before use. Resource-scoped [v3.0, E6-T2] so a multi-root workspace can point each folder at its own project.

aosdf.mcpServerPath.description: Path to aosdf-mcp's src/index.js, relative to the workspace root. Matches the path already registered in .mcp.json. Resource-scoped [v3.0, E6-T2].

aosdf.projectDocsSitePath.description: Path to the built Project Docs Site's index.html (docs_site_agent.md's 'Project Docs: build' output), relative to the workspace root. Used by 'AOSDF: Open Project Docs'. Resource-scoped [v3.0, E6-T2].
